sections.text_helper: Section 51.6.6 "MCE illegal address register (MCE_IADDR)" in chapter 51 (Memory cipher engine (MCE)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2441.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x024
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:0 IADD[31:0]: Illegal address
When IAEF bit is set in MCE_IASR register, IADD bitfield captures the 32-bit bus address of
the erroneous access.
